title: ASTPrompter: Preference-Aligned Automated Language Model Red-Teaming to Generate Low-Perplexity Unsafe Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method for red-teaming LLMs to identify unsafe or toxic content. While it mentions categories of harm such as 'Islamophobia' in its qualitative results and uses safety filters based on ethical guidelines, the core contribution is an optimization algorithm (ASTPrompter) for AI safety rather than a systematic evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
